title: Multiplicativity of degrees in a tower of finite field extensions
statement: Let $k\subseteq E\subseteq F$ be fields [def-pc-field-extension] with $E/k$ and $F/E$ finite (finite-dimensional as vector spaces). Then $F/k$ is finite and $[F:k]=[F:E]\,[E:k]$, where $[E:k]$ denotes the dimension of $E$ as a $k$-vector space.

mathlib_searches.query: tower law finrank F K times finrank K A equals finrank F A
tower law: degree of F ⊆ K ⊆ A is product of degrees, finrank F K * finrank K A = finrank F A
mathlib_searches.verdict: generalization (relative ranks of intermediate fields); the plain form is Module.finrank_mul_finrank
